description: This file defines the DashboardController class for managing user dashboards within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes methods for displaying user activity, rewards, subscriptions via Stripe, messages, mailing, and wallet functionalities, along with helper functions for sidebar creation. It interacts with models such as Invest, Mail, Comment, Project, and User, and uses external libraries like Stripe and Symfony HttpFoundation.

classes.name: DashboardController
classes.description: Controller for managing user dashboard views, including activity feed, rewards, subscriptions, messaging, mailing, and wallet management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets theme, and checks for authenticated user.

methods.name: createSidebar
methods.description: Prepares and populates sidebar menu items based on section and zone.

methods.name: activityAction
methods.description: Displays user's activity, including projects invested in and interests.

methods.name: myRewardsAction
methods.description: Displays user's investment rewards and related data.

methods.name: mySubscriptionsAction
methods.description: Shows active Stripe subscriptions for the user.

methods.name: walletAction
methods.description: Shows user's wallet and project suggestions.
